in_hebrew.name: Garwin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Garwin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Garwin is derived from the Germanic elements gar meaning spear and win meaning friend. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and was given to a boy who was considered a brave and loyal companion.
